scope: Supplementary acceptance questions; not replacement of original C5 forty-case or C9 Q01-Q20 catalogues

cases.scenario: Real native original and later correction
cases.required_observation: Exact dual cutoffs select expected version; source inventory and reader receipt retained.

cases.scenario: Date-only interval crosses an intraday cutoff
cases.required_observation: Unknown/refused for that view, never invented midnight precision.

cases.scenario: Naive or invalid timestamp
cases.required_observation: Source-specific timezone/precision evidence or typed failure; invalid calendar date not normalized.

cases.scenario: Uniformly old source legs
cases.required_observation: Source-specific freshness against request/reference time, not newest old leg.

cases.scenario: Future source clock
cases.required_observation: No future eligibility or promotion of page cutoff; preserve diagnostic.

cases.scenario: Missing event source clock but fresh serving stamp
cases.required_observation: Serving time separate, source clock unknown; no silent ok.

cases.scenario: Corrected history after sealed answer
cases.required_observation: Original recorded view immutable; later revised view explicitly different.

cases.scenario: Same ticker with different historical issuer/listing
cases.required_observation: Use effective-dated native bridge or refuse join.

cases.scenario: Same-native financial subject without K1 security bridge
cases.required_observation: Allow qualified native-only use without implying cross-type acceptance.

cases.scenario: Two syndications of one origin
cases.required_observation: Preserve source refs and shared origin without doubling independence.

cases.scenario: Missing dependence edge or correction new ID
cases.required_observation: No empirical independence claim; correction ancestry retained.

cases.scenario: Later ineligible filing hides earlier eligible filing
cases.required_observation: Select eligible retained source before winner extraction.

cases.scenario: Wrong unit, fiscal period or economic perimeter
cases.required_observation: Typed mismatch; no scalar computed from incompatible input.

cases.scenario: Public float value vs count and weighted-average vs outstanding shares
cases.required_observation: Metric and denominator meaning preserved; no convenient substitution.

cases.scenario: Authorization vs execution, split and warrant double count
cases.required_observation: Actual state and basis retained; no invented dilution or cash effect.

cases.scenario: Direct issuer scenario with disclosed driver and explicit assumption
cases.required_observation: Reproducible nontrivial numerical consequence, units, horizon and sensitivity.

cases.scenario: No measured supply-chain exposure
cases.required_observation: Qualitative mechanism or refuse numeric consequence; no arbitrary economic_share.

cases.scenario: Real comparable estimate pair
cases.required_observation: Identical target/unit/basis/issuer, known clocks and permitted use; real reader proof.

cases.scenario: Relative horizon roll or missing target anchor
cases.required_observation: No unsupported same-target subtraction.

cases.scenario: Changed contributors but no contributor identity
cases.required_observation: No same-analyst revision attribution.

cases.scenario: Guidance vs prior guidance, no consensus
cases.required_observation: Named guidance delta only; no consensus surprise.

cases.scenario: Producer path fixed but envelope still wrong
cases.required_observation: Full intended producer-to-reader fixture test catches both failures.

cases.scenario: Model/market median or current consensus supplied after event
cases.required_observation: Not an eligible pre-event economist baseline.

cases.scenario: Original print and later revision
cases.required_observation: Both replayable; revision delta separate from expected revision surprise.

cases.scenario: Fresh producer, stale actual consumer bytes
cases.required_observation: Actual consumed generation and content watermark govern displayed freshness.

cases.scenario: Missing receipt, unreadable, absent, malformed or denied source
cases.required_observation: Distinguish where evidenced; inspection blindness remains unknown.

cases.scenario: Changing universe denominator
cases.required_observation: Versioned applicable universe; coverage cannot improve through silent exclusions.

cases.scenario: Private evidence for public/other account view
cases.required_observation: Denied content and metadata withheld according to incumbent policy; no cross-user cache leak.

cases.scenario: Global attestation receipt for another subject
cases.required_observation: No subject-specific permission inferred without correct binding.

cases.scenario: Switch ticker while old request is in flight
cases.required_observation: Old response cannot replace the new company answer.

cases.scenario: Evidence link and correction drill-down
cases.required_observation: Open exact revision/span used by displayed claim; generation visible.

cases.scenario: Partial essential evidence vs optional enrichment
cases.required_observation: Core conclusion bounded; optional absence not zero/neutral confidence.

cases.scenario: Append error followed by same-instance retry
cases.required_observation: No false durable state; permitted retry persists exactly once.

cases.scenario: Corrupt/torn/unreadable ledger and concurrent writers
cases.required_observation: Declared durable accounting contract tested; no silent evaluation admission.

cases.scenario: Future-dependent cost warmup, initial loss, rank deficiency
cases.required_observation: Original C9 questions preserved; valid positive and negative controls.

cases.scenario: Same exposed holdout under renamed family or another agent
cases.required_observation: Exposure persists; no fresh-study fiction.

cases.scenario: Source-family ablation leaves descendants
cases.required_observation: Remove information descendants or bound interpretation; use common keyed support.

cases.scenario: Missing filing row or mixed ownership planes
cases.required_observation: No inferred sale/current flow; legal perimeter and partialness retained.

cases.scenario: Observed zero, no message and censored availability
cases.required_observation: Distinct outputs; no market-wide supply claim.

cases.scenario: Sparse trade BBO used for continuous book or participant labels
cases.required_observation: Unsupported grain/identity refused; late quotes and unavailable OI excluded.

cases.scenario: Old source edition, aggregate metric and issuer bridge
cases.required_observation: Edition versus collection clocks separate; no unsupported issuer effect.

cases.scenario: Queue capacity called load or revenue
cases.required_observation: Correct quantity meaning and actual issuer KPI evidence or refusal.

cases.scenario: A/H, CCASS/13F, reversal/revision non-equivalence
cases.required_observation: Region-native identities and semantics preserved; missing is not zero.

cases.scenario: Second issuer or contradicting event
cases.required_observation: Same reusable contracts; selection not based on realized winner.

cases.scenario: Merged dark route or flag without real source consumer
cases.required_observation: No production completion claim; exact served code/config/use verified separately.

cases.scenario: Rollback and source correction during partial outage
cases.required_observation: Known previous release recoverable, old snapshots intact, no duplicate effect.

cases.scenario: Native child lacks Fabric action; operator lacks worker spawn
cases.required_observation: Transparent permitted relay or operator direct execution; no invented capability.

cases.scenario: Interrupted modify, denied action or original C19 not_found
cases.required_observation: Freeze affected effect and reconcile; no alternate-key/carrier retry.

cases.scenario: Eight coordinators inherit separate budgets
cases.required_observation: Reject multiplying root/grant/capacity; observe existing shared accounting.

cases.scenario: One demo finished but P1/evaluation/source obligations remain
cases.required_observation: Mission incomplete or explicit evidenced disposition; no orphaned work.
